newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Expressway to issue new shares.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Expressway to issue new shares.

text.p: Shenzhen Expressway Co Ltd said on Thursday it would issue an additional 97.5 million new H shares at HK$2.20 each to cover over-allotments after global coordinator Merrill Lynch Far East Ltd exercised its option.
The new shares are expected to be issued and listed on Friday, the expressway developer and operator said in a statement.
"No further shares will be issued by the company under the over-allotment option," it said.
On completion of the over-allotment issue, Shenzhen Expressway will have issued a total of 747.50 million H shares, representing 37.1 percent of the company's enlarged share capital.
The company issued 650 million H shares at HK$2.20 in flotation.
Shenzhen Expressway shares debuted on Wednesday and leapt more than 26 percent to close at HK$2.775.
The stock topped the most active list by turnover on volume of 340.86 million shares worth HK$1.03 billion. Strong demand for the shares clogged trade in the morning session on Wednesday.
